observation: Round 2 exactly reproduced round 1's proxy and all GT-blind intrinsics, so setting K_height to 823.8 was effectively neutral. The successful unfolding remains healthy at 9.4 cm residual with correct orientation, 0.151 depth NaNs, 0.838 denoise retention, full ring completeness, and a coherent 10-point fallback row. The remaining distinct failure signal is zero real detections: the detected-lines image contains only sparse, short oblique fragments, while fallback supplies every prompt.
failure_mode: Fragmented joint evidence is not surviving the oblique Hough acceptance criteria, causing total fallback despite a now-healthy upstream unroll. This is a missing-lines failure rather than a ring-count or row-geometry failure; synthetic prompts are coherent, but the detector cannot contribute image-supported centres.
rationale: Preserve the strong round-1 unfolding unchanged. For the final bounded experiment, lower the oblique Hough vote threshold and increase its maximum line gap so faint, interrupted T3 joint traces can form usable oblique lines. Changing only these two coupled detection controls limits risk: vertical ring placement, pattern tolerance, denoising, and SAM geometry remain untouched, so any gain can be attributed to recovering real detections rather than disturbing the already coherent fallback layout.
